newsitem.title: UK: L-Bank sets euro Eurobonds in marks, French francs.
newsitem.headline: L-Bank sets euro Eurobonds in marks, French francs.

text.p: Baden Wuerttemberg L-Finance NV has launched two seven-year Eurobonds, a 750 million mark deal at a 10 basis points spread and a 2.0 billion French franc deal at 14 b.p. over, joint lead manager J.P. Morgan said on Thursday.
Both deals will be priced later. Guaranteed by L-Bank, they will be redenominated in euros after EMU after which they will be fungible, creating a euro Eurobond.
The two deals are worth a total of around 690 million Ecu.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is joint lead manager of the mark bond and Caisse des Depots et Consignations joint lead on the franc bond.
